body:
We've captured this separate nine-certificate update at `itsnaka/squish-certs@e63e4e52b1728b6671b2f263c5e02a4aa79a39d3`, including its source files, seed attribution and your updated summary. The next import will cover n = 88, 108, 179, 180, 199, 207, 236, 263 and 302, preserving the earlier certificates and their verification history.

The original eleven submissions from #401 are merged in #415/#416 and published as [T-113](https://jlevy.github.io/squares/all-results.html#t-113) and [T-114](https://jlevy.github.io/squares/all-results.html#t-114). The first update is separately registered in draft #421, with its exact confirmation layer in progress. This nine-certificate source revision will get its own intake layer; earlier valid n179/n263 bounds remain historical even when your newer packings supersede them.

Our intake will check complete exact rational geometry with `sqpack.verify` and `devtools.check_rational_witness_independent`, retain the submitted decimal prints separately from safe upward display ceilings, and verify the results list and case/overview drawings after deployment. We have not yet admitted new verification results for this nine-certificate batch. This issue remains open until that import, review and publication are complete.

The first-update confirmation is now saved in draft #423 above #421 in formal stack #424; its final integration checks are running. For this separate nine-certificate source, the prepared exact inputs retain all 1,762 squares and full-size overlap/containment controls. An independent mathematical input review checked every exact rotation/corner conversion and upward decimal ceiling. Five source prints (179,207,236,263,302) lie below their exact sides; the import will retain those prints and display safe upward bounds. Complete pair decisions for these nine have not run yet, so this is preparation, not confirmed feasibility or publication. The bounded replay tool is being independently checked before execution.
